title: Articles
info: A, an, and the are articles. They come before nouns.
Use a before a consonant sound: a book. Use an before a vowel sound: an apple.
The points to a specific thing: the Sun, the book on my desk.

questions.explain: Hour starts with a vowel sound, even though it is spelled with h.
University starts with a 'you' sound, a consonant sound.

questions.q: Type the article that fits: ___ elephant.
